subject: general
question: Find the radius of a hemisphere whose volume is numerically equal to its total surface area.
solution:
The correct answer is __**4.5 units**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a **hemisphere**, equate the numerical values of **Volume** and **Total Surface Area (TSA)**.

(2/3) × π × r³ = 3 × π × r²

Cancel π and r² from both sides: (2/3) × r = 3

r = (3 × 3) / 2 = 9 / 2 = 4.5 units.

**∴ The correct answer is 4.5 units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Volume of hemisphere = Total Surface Area of hemisphere.

**Formula Used:** Volume = (2/3)πr³ | TSA = 3πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06b6eff220e2df8b6d59c3ae0dd4a37db364cf18d7b7e853d8e21712d02017f1.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (2/3) × π × r³ = 3 × π × r²

⇒ (2/3) × r = 3

⇒ 2r = 9

⇒ r = 9 / 2

⇒ r = 4.5 units

**∴ The correct answer is 4.5 units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Hemisphere

The surface area of the curved part only is 2 × π × r².

Sphere Properties

For a full sphere, Volume = (4/3) × π × r³ and Surface Area = 4 × π × r².

Base Area of Hemisphere

The flat base of a hemisphere is a circle with an area of π × r².
